value.rationale: A structural, sharp modulo-three mobility transition for all complementary prisms of cycles distinguishes global optimality from local connectivity: in one residue all optimal configurations are completely frozen even under jumps, while in others they are connected by the more constrained slides. Complete natural optimum-state families and counts support this mathematical mechanism, independent of mere computational novelty.
